         APOCYNUM ANDROSAEMIFOLIUM

       Dogbane


The rheumatic symptoms of this remedy promise most curative results. Its
      pains are of a wandering nature, with much stiffness and drawing. Everything smells and tastes
      like honey. Worms. Trembling and prostration. Swollen sensations.



Extremities.--  Pain in all joints. Pain in toes and soles.
      Swelling of hands and feet. Profuse sweat, with much heat in soles. Tingling pain in toes.
      Cramps in soles. Violent heat in soles (  Sulph  ).



Dose.--  Tincture and first potency.
